content.text: No Customer-side MFN exists; the only MFN runs in our favour.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: There is no most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Customer anywhere in the Agreement. Section 12.3 expressly confirms Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment and is unrestricted in dealing with other suppliers, and the only MFN mechanic (Section 7.6) runs in our favour, with Vendor warranting that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms. That Vendor-granted MFN benefits us and is not redlined. The Agreement therefore meets the preferred position (not merely the fallback), and no right-to-match or best-terms disclosure obligation applies to Customer.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
